image_description: A grey whale surfaces in green ocean water, its dark, mottled back and dorsal knuckles visible above the waves. In the background, a small boat filled with people wearing life vests observes the whale. A person's head and shoulder are visible in the foreground right.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The whale's head is submerged or obscured by water spray; only the posterior back and dorsal area are clearly visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin on the whale's back shows characteristic mottling and lighter patches consistent with barnacle/cyamid colonization.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The whale lacks a true dorsal fin. Instead, a series of low humps (knuckles) are visible along the ridge of the back leading toward the tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body appears thick and robust, consistent with the massive scale of a grey whale relative to the boat in the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the Head_and_Face checkpoint, the body skin exhibits the expected mottled pattern.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located on the underside/lateral lower body and are not visible in this dorsal view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail flukes are submerged or out of frame; only the anterior part of the peduncle is visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface of the whale's back appears uneven and textured, consistent with rough skin and callosities/barnacles.
